name: The Golf Club at Bradshaw Farm

source.method: OpenStreetMap as drawn (API 0.6 map call, Oct 10 2026), filtered like the app's Overpass query: 26 hole ways, greens, tees, bunkers, fairways, water. A green, tee, bunker, fairway or hazard is kept within 150 m of a hole line; woods and water within 100 m. OSM tags the holes 'Blue/White' 1-18 and 'Red' 1-9, with no nine names the app can read; here each hole is named for its nine ('Red 3', 'White 4', 'Blue 7') and numbered 1-27 in card order (Red 1-9, White 10-18, Blue 19-27), so the nine map is read off the names and the Course holes screen never asks. Blue/White 1-9 is the Blue nine and 10-18 the White nine: pars and handicaps match the printed card (4/23) hole for hole.
source.traced: Not in OSM, traced from Esri World Imagery z19 (~0.25 m/px, the photo this file flies): White 4 (the par 3, OSM's missing 13): line from the back pad to the green centre, three round tee pads, the green and its two bunkers (pads measure ~186 / 151 / 120 yds to the green centre; card Blue 190, White 155, Red 119); White 3's green and its two bunkers (OSM's line ended in fairway with no green); the pond between White 4 and White 5.
source.caveat: As accurate as OSM; the traced shapes are by eye from the photo, not surveyed. No woods are mapped here, so the caddie sees no trees. Re-check White 3 and White 4 the first time they are played.

imagery.release: World Imagery Wayback 2026-09-24 (release 63116), the same tiles as live World Imagery on Oct 10 2026: winter capture, dormant turf. The traced shapes were drawn on it.
